_meta.notes: SYNTHETIC probe fixture for the Kerbalism CrewSurvival augment: a crew-critical counterpart to nominal.json. Jebediah carries Kerbalism's full ~7-rule default profile (eating, drinking, breathing, co2 poisoning, radiation, climatization, stress; operator feedback: the old fixture only carried two rules, which is why the widget only ever appeared to render two even after the overflow disclosure was removed) with radiation at 47/50 (94%, nogo tone) and a couple of others elevated into warn. Bill carries a wire-reported deathClockSec of 240s (also nogo, under the 600s SOON_DEATH_SEC threshold), so the death-clock badge shows a countdown rather than a rule percentage. Bob is fine (mirrors the nominal fixture's low accumulators) as the sorting/contrast case, same convention ShipSystems' resource-shortage.json uses (root cause pinned above a healthy row). Also carries kerbalism.spaceweather with an active storm, so the crew-status.summary vessel-wide radiation banner (summary.tsx) fires alongside the per-kerbal survival state. Emit ORDER matters, see nominal.json's own note: vessel.crew first (mints the roster rows + the crew-status.survival AugmentSlot), then kerbalism.available (the augment's requires gate), then kerbalism.crew (the Processor's own topic subscription).
